name: Houjou Ayumi
source:
[url=/c5398]Ai's[/url] classmate and the class president of their class, she is a serious girl with glasses. Despite her serious personality, Ayumi loves melodrama, and is a bit granny-like at times.

She is a first year in the same class as Ai. She is still a bit afraid of her but not as much as the other girls in the class. Everyone spreads rumors that she's an absolute beauty when she takes off her glasses.

[spoiler][url=/c5398]Ai's[/url] Childhood friend and used to call Ai as A-chan[/spoiler]
